objetivo.en_sus_palabras: I want to lose some fat and gain muscle, mainly get back the shape I had a few years ago. What worries me most is re-injuring my knee.

experiencia.detalle: I played football regularly until I was 35, then pretty much stopped. Over the last six months I've been going to the gym on and off, without much structure.

lesiones.descripcion: Torn ACL 6 years ago playing football. Had surgery and rehab at the time, medically cleared. Currently gets mild discomfort with deep squats and long lunges.

analitica_adjunta.notas: Client mentions feeling tired frequently lately. Hasn't provided bloodwork yet; still need to ask for it at follow-up.

nutricion.inquietud_principal: Would like an anti-inflammatory approach, given the old knee injury.
nutricion.contexto: Vegetarian for 10 years by personal choice, not willing to change that. Cooks little during the week due to lack of time, often relies on pre-made food.

estilo_de_vida.tipo_trabajo: very sedentary office job, long hours

notas_libres: Worried about re-injuring his knee and explicitly asks to avoid deep free squats if possible. Low sleep and high stress level — worth keeping in mind for plan adherence.
